title: Tracecat 1.4.0-alpha.3
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- refactor(agents)!: Rename the chat backend setting to session backend ([#4066](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4066) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Accept null booleans and reject bad timestamp lookups ([#4060](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4060) )


## Engine


- refactor(engine): Run semantic-search indexing on the background worker ([#4063](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4063) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Simplify git sync push and pull confirmation ([#4061](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4061) )


**Full changelog** :[1.4.0-alpha.2...1.4.0-alpha.3](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.4.0-alpha.2...1.4.0-alpha.3)
